<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.IncidentManualOutageAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Manual Incident Outages - server validated selection, native outage propagation, user initiated.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IncidentManualOutageAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var IncidentManualOutageAjax = Class.create();
IncidentManualOutageAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    isPublic:function(){return false;},
    getModel:function(){return this._call('getModel');},
    preview:function(){return this._call('preview');},
    createOutages:function(){return this._call('create');},
    _call:function(method){
        try{
            var service=new IncidentManualOutageService(),id=String(this.getParameter('sysparm_incident')||'');
            var data=JSON.parse(String(this.getParameter('sysparm_payload')||'{}'));
            return JSON.stringify({ok:true,data:service[method](id,data)});
        }catch(e){gs.warn('Incident Manual Outage: '+String(e.message||e));return JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:String(e.message||e)});}
    },
    type:'IncidentManualOutageAjax'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>chatgpt.codex</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 23:19:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>1aa56b55c344df18e079b13ed40131b8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>IncidentManualOutageAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_1aa56b55c344df18e079b13ed40131b8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>chatgpt.codex</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 23:19:15</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script><![CDATA[(function(){
    'use strict';
    var model, selected={}, checkboxes={}, children={}, reviewed='', busy=false, completed=false;
    var queryIncident=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('sysparm_incident')||'';
    var hiddenIncident=document.getElementById('mo-incident').value||'';
    var incidentId=/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(queryIncident)?queryIncident:hiddenIncident;
    var requestId='mo_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    function el(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
    function node(tag,text,cls){var n=document.createElement(tag);if(text)n.textContent=text;if(cls)n.className=cls;return n;}
    function show(id,on){el(id).classList.toggle('mo-hidden',!on);}
    function error(msg){el('mo-error').textContent=msg||'';show('mo-error',!!msg);}
    function rpc(method,payload,cb){
        var ga=new GlideAjax('IncidentManualOutageAjax');ga.addParam('sysparm_name',method);ga.addParam('sysparm_incident',incidentId);ga.addParam('sysparm_payload',JSON.stringify(payload||{}));
        ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){try{var r=JSON.parse(answer);if(!r.ok)throw new Error(r.error||'Operação não autorizada.');cb(null,r.data);}catch(e){cb(e);}});
    }
    function values(){return {targets:Object.keys(selected).filter(function(id){return selected[id];}).sort(),begin:el('mo-begin').value,end:el('mo-end').value,type:el('mo-type').value};}
    function fingerprint(){return JSON.stringify(values());}
    function controls(){var n=values().targets.length;el('mo-review').disabled=busy||completed||!n;el('mo-create').disabled=busy||completed||!n||reviewed!==fingerprint();el('mo-create').textContent='Criar '+n+' Outage'+(n===1?'':'s');el('mo-status').textContent=busy?'Processando...':completed?'Operação concluída.':n+' alvo(s) selecionado(s). Revise antes de criar.';}
    function changed(){reviewed='';show('mo-preview',false);error('');controls();}
    function choice(item,kind,container){
        var wrap=node('div',null,'mo-choice'),input=node('input');input.type='checkbox';input.id='mo-ci-'+item.id;input.setAttribute('data-kind',kind);input.setAttribute('data-ci',item.id);
        var label=node('label');label.htmlFor=input.id;label.appendChild(node('span',item.name));label.appendChild(node('span',kind==='service'?'SERVICE':kind==='offering'?'OFFERING':item.classLabel||'SERVICE INSTANCE','mo-badge'));
        wrap.appendChild(input);wrap.appendChild(label);container.appendChild(wrap);checkboxes[item.id]={input:input,wrap:wrap};
        input.addEventListener('change',function(){
            selected[item.id]=input.checked;
            if(kind==='service') (children[item.id]||[]).forEach(function(id){var c=checkboxes[id];selected[id]=false;c.input.checked=false;c.input.disabled=input.checked;c.input.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(input.checked));c.wrap.classList.toggle('mo-locked',input.checked);c.wrap.title=input.checked?'Coberta pelo Service selecionado. Desmarque o pai para selecionar a Offering.':'';});
            changed();
        });
    }
    function draw(m){
        model=m;el('mo-heading').textContent=m.incident.number+' — '+m.incident.description+' | '+m.impactedCount+' serviço(s)/CI(s) impactado(s).';
        el('mo-begin').value=m.begin.replace(' ','T');el('mo-timezone').textContent='Fuso da sessão ServiceNow: '+m.timezone+'.';
        if(!m.groups.length)el('mo-groups').appendChild(node('p','Não há Services ou Offerings nesta lista.','mo-muted'));
        m.groups.forEach(function(g){
            var card=node('div',null,'mo-card');
            if(g.parent){
                var head=node('div',null,'mo-group-head');choice(g.parent,'service',head);card.appendChild(head);
                card.appendChild(node('div','Selecionar o Service registra somente um Outage no pai. A plataforma propaga o impacto às Offerings.','mo-muted'));
                children[g.parent.id]=g.offerings.map(function(o){return o.id;});
            }else card.appendChild(node('div','Offerings sem parent — selecione individualmente','mo-group-head'));
            var offers=node('div',null,'mo-offerings');g.offerings.forEach(function(o){choice(o,'offering',offers);});card.appendChild(offers);el('mo-groups').appendChild(card);
        });
        if(!m.instances.length)el('mo-instances').appendChild(node('p','Não há Service Instances / Application Services impactados.','mo-muted'));
        m.instances.forEach(function(i){choice(i,'instance',el('mo-instances'));});
        if(m.others.length){show('mo-others',true);m.others.forEach(function(i){el('mo-other-list').appendChild(node('p',i.name+' — '+i.classLabel));});}
        show('mo-content',true);controls();
    }
    function link(table,id,text){var a=node('a',text);a.href='/'+table+'.do?sys_id='+encodeURIComponent(id);a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener';return a;}
    function preview(p){
        var box=el('mo-preview');box.textContent='';box.appendChild(node('h3','Serão criados '+p.targets.length+' Outage(s)'));
        var list=node('ul');p.targets.forEach(function(t){list.appendChild(node('li',t.name));});box.appendChild(list);
        box.appendChild(node('p','Tipo: '+(p.type==='degradation'?'Degradation':'Outage')+' | Início: '+p.begin+' | Fim: '+p.end));
        if(p.conflicts.length){
            var warning=node('div',null,'mo-warning');warning.appendChild(node('strong','Atenção: há Outages com períodos sobrepostos. A criação continua permitida.'));
            warning.appendChild(node('p','Inclui o alvo, seu pai e Offerings relacionadas. Confira as Tasks e os Outages abaixo antes de confirmar.'));
            var table=node('table',null,'mo-table'),head=node('tr');['Outage','CI / Serviço','Período','Task(s) associada(s)'].forEach(function(s){head.appendChild(node('th',s));});table.appendChild(head);
            p.conflicts.forEach(function(c){var tr=node('tr'),td=node('td');td.appendChild(link('cmdb_ci_outage',c.id,c.number));tr.appendChild(td);tr.appendChild(node('td',c.ci));tr.appendChild(node('td',c.begin+' → '+(c.end||'Em andamento')));td=node('td');c.tasks.forEach(function(t){td.appendChild(link('task',t.id,t.number));td.appendChild(node('br'));});if(!c.tasks.length)td.textContent='Sem Task informada';tr.appendChild(td);table.appendChild(tr);});warning.appendChild(table);
            if(p.moreConflicts)warning.appendChild(node('p','Exibidos os 100 primeiros registros. Consulte a lista de Outages para os demais.'));box.appendChild(warning);
        }else box.appendChild(node('p','Não foram encontrados Outages com horários sobrepostos nos alvos e relações consultados.','mo-muted'));
        show('mo-preview',true);
    }
    el('mo-begin').addEventListener('change',changed);el('mo-end').addEventListener('change',changed);el('mo-type').addEventListener('change',changed);
    el('mo-review').addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(busy)return;error('');var stamp=fingerprint();busy=true;controls();
        rpc('preview',values(),function(e,p){busy=false;if(e)error(e.message);else if(stamp===fingerprint()){preview(p);reviewed=stamp;}controls();});
    });
    el('mo-create').addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(busy||completed||reviewed!==fingerprint())return;
        var data=values();data.confirmed=true;data.requestId=requestId;busy=true;error('');controls();
        // Freeze selections while the request is in flight; retry retains the same request id.
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#mo-content input, #mo-content select'),function(i){i.disabled=true;});
        rpc('createOutages',data,function(e,r){
            busy=false;
            if(e){error(e.message+' Feche e reabra a janela para consultar a situação antes de tentar novamente.');completed=true;controls();return;}
            completed=true;var box=el('mo-result');box.textContent='';box.className='mo-success';
            box.appendChild(node('h3',r.created.length+' Outage(s) criado(s) por '+r.actor));
            r.created.forEach(function(o){var p=node('p');p.appendChild(link('cmdb_ci_outage',o.id,o.number));p.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' — '+o.ci));box.appendChild(p);});
            if(r.errors.length){var warning=node('div',r.errors.join('\n'),'mo-warning');box.appendChild(warning);}
            show('mo-content',false);show('mo-result',true);controls();
        });
    });
    el('mo-close').addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(busy)return;
        if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('sysparm_workspace')==='true'){
            // URL_CHANGED is the documented Workspace modal completion mechanism.
            location.href='/incident.do?sys_id='+encodeURIComponent(incidentId);
        }else if(typeof GlideModal!=='undefined' && GlideModal.get())GlideModal.get().destroy();
        else window.close();
    });
    rpc('getModel',{},function(e,m){if(e){error(e.message);el('mo-heading').textContent='Operação indisponível.';}else draw(m);});
})();
]]></client_script><description>Guided manual outages for impacted services. Classic and SOW.</description><direct>false</direct><endpoint/><html><?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.IncidentManualOutageService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Manual Incident Outages - server validated selection, native outage propagation, user initiated.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IncidentManualOutageService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var IncidentManualOutageService = Class.create();
IncidentManualOutageService.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    _authorized: function() {
        return gs.hasRole('itil') || gs.hasRole('sn_incident_write') || gs.hasRole('admin');
    },
    canOpen: function(incident) {
        if (!this._authorized() || !incident || incident.isNewRecord() || incident.getValue('state') != '2' || !incident.canRead() || !incident.canWrite()) return false;
        var out = new GlideRecordSecure('cmdb_ci_outage'); out.initialize();
        if (!out.canCreate()) return false;
        var rel = new GlideRecordSecure('task_cmdb_ci_service');
        rel.addQuery('task', incident.getUniqueValue()); rel.setLimit(1); rel.query();
        return rel.hasNext();
    },
    _incident: function(id) {
        if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(id || '')) throw new Error('Incidente inválido.');
        var inc = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');
        if (!inc.get(id) || !this.canOpen(inc)) throw new Error('O incidente precisa estar salvo, In Progress, possuir serviços impactados e permitir esta operação.');
        return inc;
    },
    _ci: function(id) {
        var ci = new GlideRecordSecure('cmdb_ci');
        return ci.get(id) ? ci : null;
    },
    _item: function(ci) {
        return {id: ci.getUniqueValue(), name: ci.getDisplayValue(), className: ci.getValue('sys_class_name'), classLabel: ci.sys_class_name.getDisplayValue()};
    },
    _model: function(inc) {
        var groups = {}, instances = [], others = [], allowed = {}, impacted = {}, self = this;
        var rel = new GlideRecordSecure('task_cmdb_ci_service'); rel.addQuery('task', inc.getUniqueValue()); rel.query();
        while (rel.next()) {
            var id = rel.getValue('cmdb_ci_service');
            if (!id || impacted[id]) continue;
            impacted[id] = true;
            var ci = this._ci(id); if (!ci) continue;
            var item = this._item(ci);
            if (ci.instanceOf('service_offering')) {
                var off = new GlideRecordSecure('service_offering'); if (!off.get(id)) continue;
                var parent = this._ci(off.getValue('parent'));
                var key = parent ? parent.getUniqueValue() : 'unparented';
                if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = {parent: parent ? this._item(parent) : null, offerings: [], direct: false};
                groups[key].offerings.push(item);
                allowed[id] = {item: item, parent: parent ? parent.getUniqueValue() : '', kind: 'offering'};
                if (parent && parent.instanceOf('cmdb_ci_service')) allowed[parent.getUniqueValue()] = {item: this._item(parent), parent: '', kind: 'service'};
            } else if (ci.instanceOf('cmdb_ci_service_auto') || ci.getValue('sys_class_name') == 'cmdb_ci_service_instance') {
                instances.push(item); allowed[id] = {item: item, parent: '', kind: 'instance'};
            } else if (ci.instanceOf('cmdb_ci_service')) {
                if (!groups[id]) groups[id] = {parent: item, offerings: [], direct: true};
                else groups[id].direct = true;
                allowed[id] = {item: item, parent: '', kind: 'service'};
            } else others.push(item);
        }
        var list = [];
        for (var g in groups) { groups[g].offerings.sort(function(a,b){return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);}); list.push(groups[g]); }
        list.sort(function(a,b){return (a.parent ? a.parent.name : 'ZZ').localeCompare(b.parent ? b.parent.name : 'ZZ');});
        instances.sort(function(a,b){return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);});
        return {groups:list, instances:instances, others:others, allowed:allowed, impactedCount:Object.keys(impacted).length};
    },
    getModel: function(id) {
        var inc = this._incident(id), m = this._model(inc);
        delete m.allowed;
        var opened = new GlideDateTime(inc.getValue('opened_at'));
        m.incident = {id:inc.getUniqueValue(), number:inc.getValue('number'), description:inc.getValue('short_description')};
        m.begin = opened.getDisplayValueInternal();
        m.timezone = gs.getSession().getTimeZoneName();
        return m;
    },
    _request: function(id, data) {
        var inc = this._incident(id), model = this._model(inc);
        if (!data || (data.type != 'outage' && data.type != 'degradation')) throw new Error('Selecione Outage ou Degradation.');
        if (!data || !data.targets || !Array.isArray(data.targets) || !data.targets.length || data.targets.length > 100) throw new Error('Selecione de 1 a 100 alvos.');
